title: E/11774/2017 — Zedex Clothing Pvt Ltd vs. Ahmedabad-i
text:
In The Customs, Excise & Service Tax Appellate Tribunal
West Zonal Bench At Ahmedabad
E/ROA/10274/2018-SM
Appeal No.E/11774/2017-SM
Zedex Clothing Pvt Ltd Appellant
Vs
C.C.E.- Ahmedabad-i Respondent
Represented by:
For Appellant: Shri M.K. Kothari (Consultant)
For Respondent: Shri Gobind Jha(AR)
CORAM:
HON’BLE DR. D.M. MISRA, MEMBER (JUDICIAL)
Date of Hearing/Decision: 27.04.2018
Misc. Order No. _M/__ 10334 __ /2018
Per: D. M. Misra
Heard both the sides.
2. This application is filed seeking Restoration of Appeal. I find
that this Tribunal vide order No. A/13808/2017 dated 24/11/2017,
after, analyzing the evidences on records held that the appeal filed

before the Ld. Commissioner (Appeals) has been filed beyond the
time preriod prescribed under Section 35 of Central Excise act,
1944, and, consequently dismissed the appeal filed by the appellant
before this forum.
3. I do not find any error in the said order, therefore, the
application being devoid of merit accordingly dismissed. MA (ROA)
is dismissed.
(Dictated and pronounced in the open court)
(Dr. D.M. Misra)
Member (Judicial)
seema
